context: This criteria evaluates the ability to track upload and download progress through event listeners, accessing progress metadata like bytes loaded, total bytes, and percentage.

checklist.name: Progress event listener
checklist.description: Correctly registers a progress event listener using the on method

checklist.name: Progress data access
checklist.description: Properly accesses and uses progress event data including loaded, total, percent, and direction properties

checklist.name: Bidirectional tracking
checklist.description: Demonstrates understanding that progress can be tracked for both uploads and downloads
